welcome_body: Download from the platforms you love, all in one place. Supported platforms • TikTok — videos & audio • Instagram — Reels, Posts, Videos • YouTube — videos & audio (quality selection) • Music search — type Artist - Song Subscription ⭐ Unlimited Monthly — $2 / month (paid in Telegram Stars) • Unlimited downloads • Unlimited searches • Priority queue Tap /subscription to subscribe. Tap /help for usage tips. Tap /legal for legal information.
help: How to use Downtify Bot 📹 TikTok — send any tiktok.com link, then choose Video or Audio. 📸 Instagram — send a Reel / Post / Video link. 🎬 YouTube — send a YouTube link, choose Video or Audio, then quality. 🎵 Music search — type the artist and song, e.g. Adele - Hello. Commands • /start — Restart the bot and open the welcome screen. • /menu — Open the main menu with quick access to every feature. • /help — Show this help message. • /language — Switch the bot's language. • /subscription — View or manage your Premium subscription. • /donate — Donate any amount of Telegram Stars to support the bot. • /referral — Get your referral link to invite friends and earn Premium. • /spin — Spin the daily wheel for rewards. • /legal — Read legal information. ⭐ Subscription — $2/month paid in Telegram Stars. Unlimited downloads, unlimited searches, priority queue. FAQ • Telegram file limit is 50 MB for bots. • High-quality YouTube above the limit will be sent at the best fitting quality.

legal: 🏛️ Legal Information Service Purpose: This bot provides a search and discovery service for publicly available content on various platforms. We act as an intermediary tool that helps users locate and access content that is already publicly available on the internet. Legal Framework: • Our service operates under the principle of fair use and safe harbor provisions • We do not host, store, or distribute copyrighted content • All content is sourced from publicly accessible platforms • Users are responsible for their own compliance with applicable laws Copyright Claims: We respect intellectual property rights. If you believe your copyrighted material is being infringed, send a written notice to Downtify@outlook.com including: 1. Identification of the copyrighted work (description, URL of the original) 2. Identification of the infringing material (what exactly and where) 3. Your contact information (name, email, phone) 4. A statement of good faith belief that the use is not authorized 5. A statement that the information is accurate and you are authorized to act on behalf of the copyright owner 6. Your signature (physical or electronic) Incomplete or bad-faith notices will not be processed. Repeat Infringer Policy: Users who receive three valid copyright complaints within six months will have their access to the bot permanently terminated. Counter-Notification: If your content was removed and you believe it was a mistake or misidentification, you may submit a counter-notice to Downtify@outlook.com including: 1. Identification of the removed material and its prior location 2. A statement under penalty of perjury that the removal was due to mistake or misidentification 3. Your name, contact information, and consent to jurisdiction 4. Your signature (physical or electronic) User Responsibility: Users must ensure their use of this service complies with: • Local copyright laws • Platform terms of service • Applicable international treaties Disclaimer: This service is provided "as is" for informational purposes. We do not endorse or encourage copyright infringement. Users should obtain proper licenses for commercial use of any content. Last updated: June 2026.
